a.lede: The Meta-owned social media platform now lets creators attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel to make money from Amazon more easily.
a.title: Instagram Is Bringing Amazon Affiliate Links Directly to Reels and Posts

b.lede: The announcement likely comes in response to creators' concerns over how easily original content can be copied and redistributed across social media platforms, especially considering how generative AI has made it easier to manipulate existing videos.
b.title: Instagram’s new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos
